intent: Compact read-only status or category pill set by the system.
useWhen: Status badges on table rows or cards
Category markers set by the system (user-managed labels use Tag)
doNotUseWhen: Labels the user applies, removes, or selects — use Tag

tone.note: brand is an alias of primary. highlight is a gold marker, not a warning.

onRemove.note: used when removable. Kept for dismissible filters; prefer kit Tag for user-removable labels

requirements: disabled sets aria-disabled and prevents interaction
When removable, the X control is a button with aria-label Remove {children}
If removable and disabled, the remove control does not fire
Remove control shows a focus-visible ring using --border-focus
built-in labels (remove) come from KitLabelsProvider; English by default

doNot: Do not invent a local Badge; for user-managed labels use kit Tag
Do not use Badge as a button except the remove control
